analysis.visual_description: On the board. A loose leaf, not the tied bundle. The bundle sits apart, still knotted in red. Candlelight.  The page stops before any drinking.
On the board. One word under the two lines, with a space after it. She has not drunk. The vial is named by the scene and not emptied on the page.
On the board. The red-tied bundle at the far side of the board, unopened. This leaf is not added to it.
